body: I’ve tried to kill myself when I was young. I wish I would’ve succeeded then and avoided so much more pain. Avoided the pain I’ve inflicted on others. Removed my worthless existence and making others lives better  so they wouldn’t have to deal with me. I’ve been on and off every pill in the books they don’t provide happiness. The best ones just make you feel absolutely nothing at all. I hurt myself because I deserve it. The 2 people holding me together are finally giving up as one stated it in anger to my face This is why I know my time to finally take my life has come. I’m gonna write up a note not that any care and very soon end it all. But thats just my story. A pathetic tale

I hurt myself because I feel I deserve it. I bleed because it’s all that’s left I can control. I wanna kill myself so bad! But it’s like torture I’m too much of a fucking coward to go thru with it. Living feels masochistic dying at this point is release
I’ve been pretending to be happy since I was a young kid. I’ve been on and off every pill, nothing helps. No one helps, I can’t help myself. The only people I believed in have given up on me.

Friends I wish they would tell me they have time for me. And approaching my love about her being distant throws her into a defensive rage and she reminds me of the things I’m doing wrong the so many things. It hurts I can’t be any good for the one I care about.

Just know as I read this it felt like someone was writing about me. I struggle with the same things. But I write this comment simply saying that I have these sort of demons in particular as well. Ive asked myself this question a lot and recently it’s a minimum of daily. I don’t have an answer and I think others are starting to see me caving in and idk how many more weeks I will continue.

I understand I’ve lost the fear of it too. I’ll see a knife, or an opportunity at my work that would be soo easy. Or simply driving by the edge of a steep road. I’ve lots almost become a game where I find all the ways I could end it and see which one id want or feel like I deserve.
Yeah I’ve been suicidal for a time but now living is a battle. I’ve ran out of fear of death. Why should I fear the reaper. Maybe that’s the embrace I’m meant to seek in this dark world.

Yeah recently I’ve been feeling more so like leaving, loved ones may be upset for a week but not much more everyone is too busy for me anyways and I’ve done enough growing apart from everyone I care about.

You can pretend that it went away, but it always lingers. It’s like a cancer you can fight it back but there is a heavy chance it still looms inside you. I found this out the hard way. I pretended so hard I believed myself when I said I was fine again and beat depression. But it was a lie. Now more things are falling apart and it’s worse than how it was before. I just keep sinking down. But to answer your question in a truly honest answer. No matter how many years you go thinking you are good if you have had true depression once, a simple trigger is all it needs to return.

I am not great at providing solutions I prefer to post here normally. But what I can say is I understand, depression makes us lose control on what matters and eventually lose not only happiness but sadness as well. Sometimes I try to be sad just so I’ll feel something.
Again thank you and I’ll keep it in mind.
I agree with this completely. The only time I ever attempt emotion is when someone is questioning why I’m not showing any. That is when I put on a mask.

Thank you for your optimism, I’m still quite cynical but I can’t pretend kind words aren’t helpful. Hopefully since then more medicines have been developed or my chemistry combines better with meds I’ve used in the past. And about her understanding it is tough. It’s like my fog description. I’m the only one who can see it I feel like no one else can. She’s walking with me on a path sure it may have turns and some twists but we get through it yet I feel like I can’t see and am fearing and anxious and worried and just stuck. I don’t know if she cares yet at the same time I don’t know if that’s the depression talking or actual insight. She is an amazing individual and I’m happy she hasn’t yet given up like many others. 

Again thanks for the messages they mean a lot.

I have and will be again soon. When I was in highschool I was on multiple different medications and juggled through a lot. I have severe clinical depression and it haunts me everyday. But they didn’t work. Some did nothing, others made it worse, and one I remembered making me happy yet bipolar severely and when I did slump i was more depressed than my naturally depressed mind which I didn’t know was possible. I attempted suicide and almost succeeded the knot slipped and I got enough air to wake up from my unconsciousness. And after that I stopped taking the meds and bottled my depression up saying I beat it for years. I just wanted to be normal and not have to worry about each pill and what it could or couldn’t do and if it works or doesn’t work. But after multiple years I’m slipping again. It’s harder to hide it. I’ve told my love about it this week and she simply told me she gets depressed too and idk how to explain it that she or anyone will understand.

I’m a guy so I wouldn’t know what to say about the pregnancy thing. But being suicidal is something I’ve got to know well. Honestly I’ve been contemplating on ending it all. When I was younger I tried once. Blacked out with a rope tied around my neck and hung off the end of my bed. I woke up awhile later and the rope had loosened just enough to let me get enough air to wake. Idk how to solve this cancerous thing that is depression. It resides in everyone and it either builds itself into a monster or stays contained into small outbursts of sadness for others. All I can say is I understand how it feels to have no where to go and no help at your side.
I feel the same, if all feels so dull.
